    │ shift-tab  N   previous pane (zoomed: previous session)              │
    │ ←  h           pane to the left                                      │
    │ →  l           pane to the right                                     │
    │ ↑  k           pane above                                            │
    │ ↓  j           pane below                                            │
    │ enter  z       zoom into the focused session, or back to the panes   │
    │ p              keep the focused session on the wall, even when quiet │

    │ c              prompt the focused run, or one just started           │
    │ a              approve the run's oldest request, once                │
